reviews.author: Imad Costantini

Their integrative medicine approach truly sets them apart; instead of just treating symptoms, they take the time to understand the root causes of health concerns through a holistic lens. The treatments are both innovative and effective, blending cutting-edge coordination with compassionate care. I feel more empowered and supported in my health decisions than ever before—highly recommended for anyone seeking a modern, patient-centered experience!

He helped find the right regimen that is now not only enhancing how I physically feel, but mentally feel as well. I am so grateful to him, Kerri, and truly the entire team so all they have helped me with so far - I would thank them all by name if I could!

The bottom line is I can't recommend this team or practice highly enough and am very grateful to have found them.

After working hard to regulate my hormones, regulate and thyroid meds and get some IV ozone treatment, my last tests showed NO signs of metabolic disease for the first time in over 15 years! I’m 57 and haven’t felt this good since my late 30’s! As a result, my husband and daughter are now Dr Feste’s patients and I tell everyone - run, don’t walk! Get yourself balanced. Get your life back!
Dr Feste himself practices what he preaches and is in fantastic shape for a man in his 90’s… yes! 90’s! He has a lot of wisdom and knowledge and he’s kind and gentle and most importantly his curiosity continues to keep up with what’s going on in longevity medicine.  It is clearly his passion!
Dr Feste also has experience with many top local specialists and gives wonderful referrals if you happen to need a one. Dr Feste also has some wonderful staff behind him. I can’t say enough about his nurses and supporting staff. They are always a phone call away for any questions or needs. I am thankful a friend referred me to this practice.

reviews.body:
I was referred to this amazing place by my godsend neighbor, who had all sorts of issues with her hormones and thyroid before being treated here. This clinic feels like a secret door to healthtopia. Everyone deserves to know about this place, especially women!

I have a testosterone deficiency and have struggled to build muscle following arthroscopic knee surgery. I’ve also been living with post-op chronic pain for almost a year. After seeing so many unqualified orthos across different specialties in California, who told me I have depression and labeled me with fibromyalgia (their wastebasket term, God forbid their egos get bruised when they don’t have all the answers), I feel very lucky to have found this place.

My twin sister has thyroid deficiencies and hasn’t had any luck with conventional treatments on the market either. It wasn’t a tough choice, I had to refer her to Dr. Feste.

The level of care you receive at this clinic is unparalleled. The front desk is professional and thorough. Your health is evaluated with great care, and treatment options are tailored to your specific deficiencies and needs.

No synthetic medications, forget exposing your body to drugs pushed by big pharma, designed to keep you stuck in the healthcare system for all the wrong reasons. Dr. Feste is an extremely knowledgeable practitioner, and if he can stay healthy, sharp, and vibrant well into his 90s by following his own natural treatments, so can we!

JESSICA HART, Fernanda, Barbara, Leslie, Kerry, & Doc Feste

THIS is MY TEAM AND CAN BE YOURS TOO! Coming in and seeing everybody makes my WEEK yall! Forreal when I’m having a bad time I look at my calendar see I’m goina see the fam in a few days and it always makes me smile. I come in with a smile and leave with an even bigger one. These people are not only fantastic, they are my friends! I truly love coming in and seeing everybody they make me so happy and take care of my body, my wellbeing, and above all my health and performance. They truly go above and beyond and exceed with their professionalism, their service, and their deep and knowledgeable help in wellness and medicine. As a working athlete, I need to maintain tip-top shape and this Team is a huge reason for my success scoring goals playing hockey, skating hard, and getting fit + staying fit. Any questions I have I always call Jess and she has always answered. That is top-notch medical service. We celebrate holidays together, birthdays together, and winning games together they truly have my back and we are ONE team.

My beginnings: I weighed 265lb and within just months, I started SHEDDING the weight in a healthy progressive way down to 180; I still ate, just cut out the junk food and never looked back. My most surprising thought during the process is how much more energy I felt while on Terzapatide; though I was eating much less, I felt much cleaner, and significantly much more energy than I have before (and after getting off the Trazepatide). Im sure it’s a mix of variables but the Trazepatide truly helps with weight loss while maintaining and being a key source for more clean energy, too! I was running 6miles on average every 3 days, while doing double skate sessions every day, and 3 games per week. The stamina and energy bar was at an all time high - like I’ve never felt before. That is why to this day I continue to see the wonderful team at Vital Health, my friends, and who I consider family every week even just to drop in and see some friendly and loving smiles and share a laugh together. I have a belief in my head that although everyone in the office is high in their sense of humor, I believe Dr Feste’s got the best jokes in the league if you ask me ;) Overall, I 20 out of 10 recommend this place for anyone looking to boost their numbers, performance, health, and wellness uptakes and they will all treat you with so much care and love they are all truly the absolute bestest. Hands down you won’t be disappointed.
